priority_basis: Current product page is published but has no verified external traffic or sales. An evergreen, high-intent free article can create organic discovery and direct readers to the paid product without advertising spend.

article.topic: YouTube AI Shorts monetization, mass-produced content policy, AI disclosure

automation_review.direct_execution: Article research, structure, draft, official-source links, CTA, validation and launcher generation are completed in the repository.
automation_review.official_api: note does not have a connected authenticated publishing action in the current tool set.
automation_review.browser_prefill: A mobile HTML launcher copies the title and body and opens https://note.com/new.
automation_review.batching: Title, body, source links, product CTA and editor launch are consolidated into one page.
automation_review.verification: CI validated title length, body length, source presence, CTA presence and absence of placeholders.
automation_review.credentials: No credentials, cookies or personal data are stored.

residual_user_action.reason: Final publication in the user's note account requires the authenticated account holder.
steps: Open the generated launcher and copy the prepared article.
Open the note editor, paste the title/body and confirm final publication.

success_condition: The free article is publicly available and its CTA links to the paid product.
next_assistant_actions: After publication, add the public article URL to distribution and metrics tracking.
Evaluate a second evergreen article only after the first article receives measurable traffic or after seven days without traffic.
